name: herdr
description: Installs herdr, a terminal workspace manager for AI coding agents, for the remote user, with optional plugins and agent skills.

plugins.description: Comma-separated list of herdr plugins to install from GitHub (herdr plugin install ENTRY --yes). Each entry is owner/repo or owner/repo/subdir. Skipped when empty.

skills.description: Comma-separated list of agent skill sources to install globally via the skills CLI (npx skills add). Each entry accepts owner/repo shorthand (e.g. vercel-labs/agent-skills) or a full GitHub URL. Requires skillsAgent. Node.js is installed on demand. Skipped when empty.

skillsAgent.description: Agent id the skills are installed for (skills CLI -a flag), e.g. claude-code, kiro-cli or hermes-agent. herdr is not an agent itself, so there is no default; when skills is set but this is empty a warning is printed and no skills are installed.
